import pandas as pd

# Load the time_series_data.csv dataset
df_time_series = pd.read_csv('/data/time_series_data.csv')

# Find the index of the maximum 'Depot' value
max_index = df_time_series['Depot'].idxmax()

# Find the corresponding 'CE' value
peak_ce = df_time_series.loc[max_index, 'CE']

# Check the 'Depot' values around the peak
peak_depot = df_time_series.loc[max_index, 'Depot']
before_peak = df_time_series.loc[max_index - 1, 'Depot']
after_peak = df_time_series.loc[max_index + 1, 'Depot']

peak_ce, peak_depot, before_peak, after_peak
